rules.rationale: Base equation for the mathematical scanner: with no remaining input, scanParenGroups is defined to return the accumulated output.
Structurally recursive defining equation for scanParenGroups on a nonempty IntSeq; its conditionals define the accumulator, depth, and group updates while recursion consumes REST.
Wrapper equation defining separateParenGroupsSpec by initializing scanParenGroups with depth zero and empty current-group and output accumulators.
Wrapper equation defining the valid-input predicate as validParenSuffix started at nesting depth zero.
Base equation for validParenSuffix, defining an exhausted input as valid exactly when the tracked nesting depth is zero.
Recursive predicate equation defining ASCII space as ignored while checking the remaining suffix at the unchanged depth.
Recursive predicate equation defining an opening parenthesis to increase nesting depth before checking the remaining suffix.
Guarded recursive predicate equation defining a closing parenthesis at positive depth to decrease depth and continue checking the suffix.
Guarded defining equation making a closing parenthesis at nonpositive depth invalid, completing the close-parenthesis cases.
Guarded catch-all defining equation making every code other than ASCII space, opening parenthesis, or closing parenthesis invalid.
